LanguageData.JTA_Url: Server address, anything that answers like OpenAI: vLLM, llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama
LanguageData.JTA_Model: Model, empty takes the first one the server has
LanguageData.JTA_Key: API key, empty for most local servers
LanguageData.JTA_AskFirst: Ask before running commands that change the game
LanguageData.JTA_AskFirstTip: It shows the commands and waits for y. Off, they run right away.
LanguageData.JTA_ToolsTip: How the model asks for things, not what it can do. The only tools are the terminal's own: read runs a read command, change runs an edit command, write_file writes a file in the save's ~ and remember keeps a line, the last three after your y. Nothing runs on your computer and no real files are touched. Off, the model asks the same way in plain lines, for servers without tool calling.
LanguageData.JTA_ThinkTip: Slower, and some models think until they run out of tokens. Off asks the model to answer right away, models that don't know the option ignore it.
LanguageData.JTA_Steps: Most steps for one ai line
LanguageData.JTA_Timeout: Seconds to wait for an answer
